Source inspection of these selected methods finds no route to windup Some with active None. The production expect nevertheless violates the explicit outside-test rule.

observations.trace: The selected resolver constructs target_character once from event.target and a read-only query, then maps that same Option to separation, aim, position and yaw. For a target, validation rejects missing separation or false/missing aim before its two position/yaw expects; if target_character is Some those latter mappings are Some. ValidatedRangedImpact::Miss is intentional for target None.
observations.remaining: The actual selected producer provides a coherent bundle; independently inconsistent facts could reach the expects only if another caller constructs them, and no such production caller is established here. Outside-test expects still violate the repository rule. observations.trace: The reciprocal branch rejects active.start at or before incoming.start, so native Duration delay is at least one nanosecond, whose as_secs_f32 is positive. Its division is inside a closure guarded by delay <= window; a zero window cannot enter it. CombatInstant arithmetic uses saturating addition and subtraction.
observations.remaining: This independently rechecks the earlier scoped PL13 rejection for selected source only; exhaustion policy, all inputs and clock lifecycles remain open. No timing or native RNG ran.

observations.trace: The authority constructs a ContactTimingOffset from ready_at.elapsed_since(now), whose subtraction saturates at zero. The selected core committed-threat consumer sends all nonpositive offsets to FinishTrade and treats their completed-work fraction as one, so the lost negative sign and zero have the same result at that selected branch.
observations.remaining: Other consumers, scheduling and intended clock semantics remain open; no behavior discrepancy or product event is established.
